propositions: When tool_step_limit cutoff is reached after a tool has already been invoked, pydantic-ai omits toolConfig from subsequent requests while message history contains toolUse blocks, causing Bedrock and Anthropic to reject with a 400 ValidationException
The current filtered-toolset mechanism that hides tools entirely violates the provider protocol requirement that toolConfig must be defined when toolUse/tool_use blocks exist in history

The convergence boundary mechanism must be changed from hiding tools to returning synthetic steering results that tell the model tool execution is no longer available, keeping tool definitions advertised throughout the run
Tool definitions must remain non-empty and advertised on every request after the limit is exceeded to satisfy provider protocol constraints
Terminal budget exhaustion via UsageLimits still applies if a model ignores steering and keeps issuing tool calls, providing a hard backstop against infinite loops
